question: Identify a suitable title for the passage above.
solution:
The correct answer is Reservation for Equality. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's have a look at the points given below:
 
 
• The given passage initially talks about how **the Constitution (One Hundred and Twenty Fourth Amendment) Bill, 2019, seeks to provide for the advancement of 'economically weaker sections' of citizens.**
 
• Then we get to know about **Article 15 of constitution and the discrimination against any citizen on the grounds of race, religion, caste, sex or place of birth.**
 
• Then, we learned about **t****he Bill seeks to amend Article 15 to additionally permit the government to provide for the advancement of 'economically weaker sections**.
 
 
 
• ​Upon perusal of the above statements, it can be concluded that Reservation for Equality is the suitable title of the passage.
